name: Chicken, Gnocchi & Vegetable Soup with Lemon-Basil Gremolata

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 ½ small pkgs fresh basil
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the veggies, chicken, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies start to soften and chicken is almost cooked through, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a boil.
Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; place in a small bowl.
Peel and mince additional garlic; add to the bowl with the basil.
Zest and juice lemons into the bowl; add oil and stir to combine the gremolata. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies and chicken and done, add gnocchi to the soup and continue to simmer, uncovered, until gnocchi start to float to the surface, 5-6 minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with gremolata. Enjoy!
